_status: Approved by the user (follow-up B). Nifty 50 index options only.
holiday_rule: If the day a rule names is not a trading day, the expiry is the PREVIOUS trading day. Source: NSE contract specifications (https://www.nseindia.com/static/products-services/equity-derivatives-contract-specifications: 'If the Tuesday is a trading holiday, then the expiry day is the previous trading day'); NSE/FAOP/68685 Annexure (Oct 2025 weekly moved to 1-Oct 'since 02-Oct-25 is holiday'); confirmed by every holiday-shifted expiry in the real expiry list 2024-10..2026-09 (tests/test_bt_expiry.py).

rules.applies_to: weekly: Thursday of the week; monthly / quarterly / half-yearly: last Thursday of the month
rules.source: Weekly Nifty options were already on Thursdays before 2022. No circular changed the day between 2022-01-01 and 2025-08-31: NSE/FAOP/66938 (4 Mar 2025, table 'current expiry day': Thursday / last Thursday) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP66938.pdf ; NSE/FAOP/68685 (23 Jun 2025, 'existing': Thursday) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP68685.pdf . Real expiries 2024-10-03..2025-08-28 (Upstox Get Expiries) are all Thursdays except holiday shifts. NOT independently verified for 2022-01..2024-09 (Upstox keeps no expired contracts before 2024-10-03): rule-based there.

rules.applies_to: weekly: Tuesday of the week; monthly / quarterly / half-yearly: last Tuesday of the month
rules.source: SEBI/HO/MRD/TPD-1/P/CIR/2025/76 (26 May 2025) https://www.sebi.gov.in/sebi_data/attachdocs/may-2025/1748266377271.pdf ; NSE/FAOP/68589 (17 Jun 2025: expiries on/before 31 Aug 2025 stay Thursday, on/after 1 Sep 2025 Tuesday) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP68589.pdf ; NSE/FAOP/68685 (23 Jun 2025) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP68685.pdf ; NSE/FAOP/68747 (update) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP68747.pdf . Real expiries: last Thursday weekly 2025-08-28, first Tuesday weekly 2025-09-02, monthly 2025-09-30.

considered_and_not_a_rule.what: NSE plan to move Nifty weekly/monthly expiry to MONDAY from 2025-04-04
considered_and_not_a_rule.why: Announced in NSE/FAOP/66938 (4 Mar 2025), deferred 'until further notice' by NSE/FAOP/67338 (27 Mar 2025, https://www.steelcitynettrade.com/Circulars/Revision%20in%20Expiry%20Day%20of%20Index%20and%20Stock%20Derivatives%20Contracts%20%E2%80%93%20Update.pdf) after SEBI's consultation paper of 27 Mar 2025. Never in force: the real expiries in Apr-Aug 2025 are Thursdays.

considered_and_not_a_rule.what: Weekly options on BANKNIFTY / MIDCPNIFTY / FINNIFTY discontinued from 2024-11-20
considered_and_not_a_rule.why: NSE/FAOP/64506 (10 Oct 2024) https://nsearchives.nseindia.com/content/circulars/FAOP64506.pdf keeps Nifty 50 as the only weekly index: no change for Nifty's own expiry days.
